source_event.source: Raoul Pal X post supplied as screenshots

claims.claim: Bitcoin is 87% correlated to global liquidity
claims.success_condition: frozen method reproduces approximately 0.87 and remains materially high out of sample
claims.failure_condition: result depends on levels, dual-axis scaling, selected lag, selected window, or fails out of sample

claims.claim: Nasdaq is 97% correlated to global liquidity
claims.success_condition: frozen method reproduces approximately 0.97 and remains materially high out of sample
claims.failure_condition: result depends on levels, dual-axis scaling, selected lag, selected window, or fails out of sample

claims.claim: Bitcoin and Nasdaq mainly track the amount of money in the system rather than earnings, news or weekly narratives
required_replication: incremental value after rates, earnings, valuation, credit, dollar and crypto-native controls
claims.success_condition: liquidity adds stable out-of-sample explanatory and predictive value after controls
claims.failure_condition: liquidity is redundant, unstable, or loses value after conditioning

claims.claim: Interest payments lead liquidity by around three years
claims.success_condition: a preregistered approximately 36-month lead survives walk-forward, real-time vintages and family-wise correction
claims.failure_condition: lead is selected ex post, unstable, or disappears under vintages and controls

claims.claim: Liquidity can be forecast years ahead because future interest payments are already known
claims.success_condition: interest-payment-based model improves real-time forecasts of realised liquidity against simple baselines
claims.failure_condition: forecast error is dominated by rates, issuance, policy or transmission changes

claims.claim: Bitcoin is currently running cold relative to liquidity and nothing is broken
claims.success_condition: negative residual predicts superior forward payoff after regime and drawdown controls
claims.failure_condition: residual is non-stationary, persistent, or fails to predict future returns
